process.title: CO2 electrolysis to CO, two 0.1 kg/h pilot skids (reverse-bias BPM, 28 cells of 100 cm2 each)
process.technology: CO2 electrolysis to CO in reverse-bias bipolar-membrane cells (Ag gas-diffusion cathode, Ni foam anode, KOH anolyte), 28 cells of 100 cm2 in four stacks on a 48 V DC bus at 200 mA/cm2, PSA gas conditioning with 0.95 CO2 recycle and tail-gas oxidation; Skid A one 1 M KOH fill per campaign, Skid B continuous 5 M KOH dosing, bleed and make-up

design_case.description: Skid A runs: 4 x 7 cells at 200 mA/cm2 on one fill of 1 M KOH that lasts the campaign (duty D-A); train B idle

applicability.limitations: 5 to 100 cm2 scale-up and campaign duration extrapolated
